# technitium_app (Resource)

Installs a DNS app from a download URL, such as one from the DNS App Store. Changing the URL updates the app in place; destroying the resource uninstalls it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_app" "split_horizon" {
  name = "Split Horizon"
  url  = "https://download.technitium.com/dns/apps/SplitHorizonApp-v11.zip"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The app name, for example `Split Horizon`. Changing it replaces the app.
- `url` (String) The `https://` URL of the app's zip file, for example `https://download.technitium.com/dns/apps/SplitHorizonApp-v11.zip`. The server does not return it, so an app updated outside Terraform is seen through `version`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether the DNS App Store has a newer version.
- `update_version` (String) The newest version in the DNS App Store.
- `version` (String) The installed version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_app.split_horizon "Split Horizon"
```
